purpose: Bind every human-review still view, 100% crop and temporal probe reference to the canonical evidence identities actually produced by the Unity capture pipeline. This contract closes configuration-drift gaps but never substitutes for pixel review.

notes: The allowed review view set must equal the manifest viewId set; neither extra review aliases nor unreviewable manifest views are allowed.
The allowed review crop set must equal the manifest viewId/cropId set, and each id must resolve to exactly one canonical dimension-bearing file path.
Pixel-exact bytes, dimensions and SHA-256 sealing remain the responsibility of render-evidence provenance QA.
The allowed temporal-review reference set must equal the canonical temporal probe id set.
Sealed frame/crop byte provenance remains the responsibility of temporal runtime evidence QA.
